_help: Act 2: journal clues found in Cairo (not walk-up sites; the Act 2 talks write them with the journal effect).

archive.name: The Museum Archive
archive.desc: Boxes nobody has opened since before the war

clue.title: The Akmentar papers
clue.text: The travellers' accounts agree on little, but three of them mention a temple of three gods, Anubis, Horus and Ra, standing before the tomb, and a king 'whose name the priests cut from the walls'. A burned map puts the site west of the river, beyond the last well.

archive_extra.name: The Locked Cabinet
archive_extra.desc: A field report that was never published

clue.title: Blackwood's first expedition
clue.text: A field report from Sir Reginald Blackwood's first expedition: 'We found the door. Mr. Ashby insists that something followed us back to camp. Two of the workers have gone.' The report stops there.

clue.title: The last telegram
clue.text: Blackwood's London office answers your wire. The first expedition's last telegram came from a desert town on the coast road: 'Site found. Sending for more men. Do not tell the museum.' Nothing came after it.
